results.title: Changelog - Macaly Documentation
results.content:
Add Macaly Cloud to Claude or ChatGPT, describe the website or app you want in the chat, and Macaly handles the database, hosting, domain, and the 70+ skills your project needs to go live.Building and publishing run on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription and cost no Macaly credits. Some skills, such as AI features inside your app, can still require credits.Every project is saved to your Macaly account, so you can open it like any other project and carry on editing it there.Learn more about Macaly Cloud

​

## ​ New features

### ​ Visual edits, redesigned

Adjust styles, swap images, and rewrite text directly in the live preview. When something is easier to show than to describe, sketch it onto the exact spot you mean. Most edits apply instantly and cost no credits. [...] ## ​ Bug fixes

 Projects you had not opened for a while could open with an older version of your files. Your latest changes now stay exactly as you left them
 Some published sites showed the text “Made with AI in Macaly” in Google search results, even when the badge was turned off. Republish your site to apply the fix
 Connecting Macaly to your Telegram account sometimes got stuck on “Waiting for your connection”. That’s fixed, and commands like `/help` work again
 When you come back to Macaly in your phone’s browser, you no longer see a “session expired” error

​

## ​ New features

### ​ Macaly Cloud lets you build and publish projects straight from Claude or ChatGPT [...] ### ​ Protect your site with a password

When your published site is meant only for a client or your team, you can now lock it with a password straight from your project settings. Visitors don’t even need a Macaly account. Available on the Pro and Agency plans.

### ​ Try out ideas in a separate version of your project

Want to experiment with new features or a new design on your site? Macaly now lets you create variants of your project, each with its own chat. If you like how the changes turn out, publish the variant over your current version, or go back to the original at any time.
